name: B_u64div_coord
desc: EXACT 45_dual_gemm shape: a signed 64-bit magic-reciprocal DIVIDE (I2F.U64.RP -> MUFU.RCP -> VIADD +0x1FFFFFFE -> F2I.U64.TRUNC + Newton-Raphson) whose QUOTIENT feeds a 64-bit address index (coord*stride), like dual_gemm's grid-strided coord=index/N. This codegen makes ptxas emit the pre-correction remainder HIGH word as IADD3.X (vs IMAD.X for a direct quotient store). IntDivRecognize must BOTH recognize the IADD3.X rem-hi form (_match_rem_hi) AND recover the quotient as UDIV64/UDIV64HI (_find_precorr_quotient_pair) — the remainder rewrite alone only suppresses the +1 correction, locking in the faithful software-rcp (wrong) NR quotient. Quotient written to out[coord]; value-verified, crash-safe (coords distinct/in-bounds).
